observations: 2014 BMC Research Notes study titled “The novel surfactant protein SP-H enhances the phagocytosis efficiency of macrophage-like cell lines U937 and MH-S.”

entities.name: SP-H (SFTA3)
observations: Recombinant SP-H was tested for effects on in-vitro phagocytosis in macrophage-like cells.

entities.name: SP-H increases phagocytosis
observations: In-vitro fluorescent latex-bead assays report markedly increased phagocytosis with recombinant SP-H in murine MH-S and differentiated human U937 cells; numerical effect sizes are unavailable in the retrieved abstract/excerpt.
